adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` tries to express an index signature via computed keys like `[z.string().toString()]`, but that evaluates to a single literal property name (e.g. "[object Object]"/"ZodString"), not a catchall. Since `z.object(...)` strips unknown keys by default, fields such as `expiry_date`/`expires_in`/`scope` won’t be preserved when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` triggers this schema path, matching the finding’s claim about lost token fields.
